page.content:
Hand-pressed oblong of sushi rice topped with a slice of fish or egg.

How Nigiri connects

  • Topic: Edomae sushi — Nigiri is the central form of Edomae sushi.
  • Character: Hanaya Yohei — Hanaya Yohei is credited with popularizing street nigiri in Edo.
  • Item: Wasabi — Wasabi is traditionally placed between rice and fish on nigiri.
  • Item: Soy sauce — Soy sauce is brushed or dabbed on nigiri rather than used to soak the rice.
  • Item: Otoro — Otoro is a luxury tuna neta served as nigiri.
  • Item: Tamago — Tamago is a cooked omelet nigiri used as a house signature.

What is Nigiri?

Nigiri-zushi is the Edomae unit: shari in the palm, neta on top, sometimes a brush of soy or a smear of wasabi between.

Key threads lead to Edomae sushi, Hanaya Yohei, Wasabi, Soy sauce, Otoro and Tamago.
